criticalWarnings.title: Fake NSDL / CDSL Bonus Share Stamp Duty PDF
criticalWarnings.summary: Depositories NEVER demand advance stamp duty or clearing fees via WhatsApp PDFs or private UPI links (watch for typosquatting like nsdI-portal.org.in).

criticalWarnings.title: Deepfake Finfluencer Reels & Telegram VIP Pump Groups
criticalWarnings.summary: SEBI strictly prohibits guaranteed returns (e.g., 'Double in 5 Days'). Over 90% of VIP Telegram groups orchestrate pump-and-dump traps on illiquid penny stocks.

criticalWarnings.title: Demat OTP Harvesting via Fake Dividend Links
criticalWarnings.summary: Dividends are credited automatically to your linked bank account via ECS. Never enter your PAN or Demat OTP on third-party links to 'claim' dividends.

criticalWarnings.title: Digital Arrest & Fake SEBI/CBI Video Call Extortion
criticalWarnings.summary: Police, CBI, Customs, and SEBI officers NEVER conduct 'Digital Arrests' over WhatsApp/Skype video calls or ask for 'verification transfers' to RBI escrow accounts.
